status: exploratory robustness requested after 12G and 12H outcomes were viewed
text_direction: sign of pre-existing quarterly net_score among firms meeting either original seed flag
embedding_support: RS-L-Min 10D cosine propagation from all other directionally resolved LLM seeds; target firm's own seed is excluded
consensus_long: positive text direction and positive leave-one-seed-out embedding support
consensus_short: negative text direction and negative leave-one-seed-out embedding support
weighting: equal weight within leg; long-short is +100 percent long and -100 percent short
matched_text_comparator: same leg counts, highest absolute net text scores within direction
placebos: 100 random matched-cardinality draws from embedded LLM-labeled firms within the same text direction
return_horizon: same frozen three-month windows as 12G and 12H
